data.name: Clarita
data.gender_notes: Clarita is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin clarus (clear, bright, light), Clarita is a name of radiant and shining meaning. In the Christian context, it can be associated with the light of faith and spiritual clarity. The name Clarita carries the meaning “Clear, Bright, Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Clarita usually hope their child will grow to embody clear, bright, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light and clarity in spiritual journeys.
data.etymology: Clarita belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Clear, Bright, Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Clarita total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_english.name: Clarita
in_english.meaning: clear, bright, and holy, daughter of plenty, a young woman consecrated to God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Clarita is derived from the Latin words for clear, bright, and holy. This name is associated with the angel who brings blessings and is a term used by Jesus to describe the blessings. The name Clarita is also associated with the concept of plenty, as it is derived from the Latin word for abundance. In the Christian tradition, the name Clarita is seen as a symbol of spiritual enlightenment and guidance.
